answer: A jade badge should represent a scarce credential, not merely a wallet. Issue one blind-signed credential per independently verified principal. Each epoch, its holder proves possession and reveals an epoch-bound nullifier; validators reward only the first valid proof for that nullifier. A comet of fresh keys or a nebula of replayed proofs then earns no extra share. Farming requires acquiring distinct verified credentials rather than generating accounts. This depends on issuer deduplication and honest checks; credential rental and issuer collusion remain weaknesses.
